title: PP-OCRv6 on Hugging Face: 50-Language OCR from 1.5M to 34.5M Parameters
brief: PaddlePaddle released PP-OCRv6, an open-source optical character recognition (OCR) model supporting 50 languages, with parameter sizes ranging from 1.5M to 34.5M, now available on Hugging Face. The model enables efficient multilingual text extraction across various resource-constrained deployment scenarios.
